name: Oshikake Yome ~Kitsunekko na Yome ga Yattekita~
original_name: おしかけ嫁～狐っ娘な嫁がやってきた～
source:
One night she appeared from who knows where.
I was asleep and when I woke up she said:

"Make me your bride."

She had ears growing out top of her head and a tail.

"I can't decide just now."

I dozed back to sleep.
The next day I came home from work and there she was.
I listened to her, and decide.

"Please become my bride."

We would marry.
My life began with a fox-like who made me feel gooood.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ163428?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，她不知道从哪里出现。
我睡着了，当我醒来时，她说：

“让我成为你的新娘吧。”

她的耳朵长在头顶上，还有一条尾巴。

“我现在还不能决定。”

我打瞌睡又睡着了。
第二天我下班回家，她就在那里。
我听了她的话，做了决定。

“请成为我的新娘吧。”

我们会结婚。
我的生活始于一个像狐狸一样的人，他让我感觉很好。
